audience: online sellers who print and ship phone cases through PrintPoss

useCases.title: Track orders in production and shipping
useCases.text: List your orders with their status and payment status. Open one for its packages and tracking.

useCases.title: Find product variant ids
useCases.text: List your stores and the products with their variants, to find a product variant id.

useCases.title: Check spend on order payments
useCases.text: List the wallet transactions for top-ups, order payments and refunds, with the balance after each.

useCases.title: Create a fulfillment order
useCases.text: Create a print-on-demand order that is printed and shipped to the buyer. It charges your wallet and cannot be cancelled here.
